title: Keyframe Animation Editor
description:
The new update to our Animation Editor in CLO 2025.0 allows you to elevate animations by applying keyframes to various components, creating dynamic and sophisticated visuals. Check out other new features here: https://www.clo3d.com/en/clo/features
